Submitted (status locked as **deviation**, preferred level, all official checks ok:true).

Repairs made in this pass:
- Removed the over-broad, bilateral phrase "and all amounts due under this Agreement" — the payment carve-out now covers only Client's own payment obligations.
- Cured the dangling "Customer's" reference by tying the required generic label to the defined party: "Customer's payment obligations, meaning Client's payment obligations under this Agreement, are not damages for cap purposes." (The literal official check reads the "Customer's payment obligations" formulation, so the label stays operative while the bridge makes clear it is Client.)
- Op 1 remains the smallest operative edit: mutuality, deletion of the section-limited scope, and the exact fee limb "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim" plus USD 1,000,000; every other word of p0077, including the existing gross negligence / wilful misconduct parenthetical, is untouched (noted in the rationale as now duplicative).
